blocks.label: Actor enters volume
blocks.description: Runs the program when an actor walks into this trigger's box (CTrigger actorEnterEvent).

blocks.label: Actor leaves volume
blocks.description: Runs the program when an actor walks out of this trigger's box (CTrigger actorLeaveEvent).

blocks.label: Actor group dead
blocks.description: Polled every tick: every member of the group has no hit points left (isActorGroupDead).

blocks.label: Actor dies
blocks.description: Bound with setDeathEvent in setupLevel; the actor must exist at load.

params.name: actor
params.doc: a CCharacter placed in the level

blocks.label: All players downed
blocks.description: Polled every tick: every CGhostbuster actor's getHitPointsPct is zero.

blocks.label: Checkpoint loaded
blocks.description: Runs when the game resumes at the named checkpoint (inside checkpoint_<name>()).

blocks.label: Timer
blocks.description: Runs after the given seconds of level time have passed, counted with gTimeSlice.

blocks.label: Spawn character
blocks.description: CSpawn::spawnCharacter through a per-class wrapper; a dormant actor of the same class, cit and variant must be placed in the level.

params.name: cls
params.doc: CBiped, CFloater, CFlyerSmall, CFlyerMedium, CScuttler, CBipedLarge

params.name: group
params.doc: actor group to add the spawn to, optional

blocks.label: Kill actor group
blocks.description: killGroupMembers from global.dante: every live member dies.

blocks.label: Enable actor
blocks.description: CActorBase::enable(true).

blocks.label: Disable actor
blocks.description: CActorBase::enable(false).

blocks.label: Warp actor
blocks.description: CActorBase::warpTo(pos, orient).

blocks.label: Camera: fixed post
blocks.description: gMainView.setCameraModeFixed(camera, target, blend); hand the camera back with camera_normal.

blocks.label: Camera: orbit
blocks.description: gMainView.setCameraModeOrbit around an actor for a number of seconds.

blocks.label: Camera: normal
blocks.description: gMainView.setCameraModeNormal(0, 0): the player has the camera again.

blocks.label: HUD message
blocks.description: displayMessage(eHudMessage_ObjectivesUpdated, text, seconds); -1 keeps it until replaced.

blocks.label: Set objective
blocks.description: setCurrentObjective(long text) and the short banner, the shipped pair.

blocks.label: Start effect
blocks.description: startEffect(name, pos, orient); the effect is cached in setupLevel.

params.name: at
params.doc: actor whose position and orientation to use, optional

params.name: pos
params.doc: used when no actor is given

blocks.label: Play sound
blocks.description: startSfx(name); cached in setupLevel.

blocks.label: Set music
blocks.description: setMusic(cue); an empty cue stops the music.

blocks.label: Wait
blocks.description: wait(seconds) from global.dante; the program runs on its own thread when it waits.

blocks.label: Save checkpoint
blocks.description: saveCheckpoint(text of the named checkpoint); needs a define_checkpoint with that name.

blocks.label: Define checkpoint
blocks.description: Declarative: defineCheckpoint in setupLevel plus a checkpoint_<name>() export. Emits nothing where it sits in a program.

blocks.label: Enable trigger
blocks.description: CActorBase::enable on another trigger.

blocks.label: Raw Dante
blocks.description: Statements pasted verbatim into the handler.
